scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @opulya/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace @opulya/shared && npm run build --workspace @opulya/api && npm run build --workspace @opulya/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @opulya/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:e2e && npm run typecheck:tooling
scripts.test:integration: tsx --tsconfig apps/api/tsconfig.typecheck.json --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/api/test/integration.test.ts apps/api/test/market.test.ts apps/api/test/auth-throttle.test.ts apps/api/test/balance-snapshots.test.ts apps/api/test/category-lifecycle.test.ts apps/api/test/account-lifecycle.test.ts apps/api/test/asset-library.test.ts apps/api/test/instrument-directory.test.ts apps/api/test/investment-corrections.test.ts apps/api/test/email-verification.test.ts apps/api/test/email-send-limits.test.ts apps/api/test/migrations.test.ts
